trap-superlative.notes: STRUCTURAL FINDINGS (report only). (1) TERMINOLOGY: 'The Kazhdan-Lusztig basis polynomials {P_{y,w}(q)} are the STRUCTURE CONSTANTS of this decategorification.' P_{y,w} are change-of-basis coefficients - C'_w = sum_{y <= w} P_{y,w}(q) T_y expresses the KL basis in the standard basis - not structure constants of the algebra. The downstream claim that they are integers at q = 1 is correct either way. (2) The conjecture has NO formal content anywhere in the tree. I ran both checks: that path does not exist (ls: No such file or directory), and the .md has no section of that name (grep for 'Lean axiomatisation' returns nothing). So both pointers in the stub's docstring are dead in the present tree.
